# ubik guide

> Use Ask ubik, Inbox, Tasks, and reviewed workflows. Watch six short lessons from connected question to tested workflow update.

## Start

- [Getting started](https://docs.theubik.com/index.md): Choose Read or Watch.
- [Operator habits](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/workspace-basics.md): Review sources, owners, writes, and closure evidence; open settings or contact the founders.

## Read

- [Ask ubik](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/ask-ubik.md): Attach useful context and review the artifact it creates.
- [Inbox](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/inbox.md): Read the source thread, inspect decision-changing context, then move the work.
- [Tasks](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/tasks.md): Track who owes the next move and what proves completion.
- [Workflows](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/workflows.md): Map two or three loops in Week 1, ship one reviewed workflow, then measure its result.

## Watch

- [Six-state walkthrough](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/watch.md): Switch between Ask ubik, Inbox, Tasks, Workflows, Trade memory, and Finetuning without opening another page.

## Settings

- [Connected tools](https://docs.theubik.com/admin/integrations.md): Set read, draft, and reviewed-write boundaries.
- [Security and data](https://docs.theubik.com/admin/security-and-data.md): Review sensitive context and reporting rules.
